botMessages.message: Thanks for calling. This is the HVAC service agent. How can I help you today?
Sorry, something went wrong on my end. Could you say that again?

conversationVariables.description: The agent instructions
conversationVariables.label: Agent Instructions

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for if statements
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 1

conversationVariables.description: The next topic to be visited
conversationVariables.label: Next Topic

conversationVariables.description: True when an existing appointment was located.
conversationVariables.label: Appointment Found

conversationVariables.description: The confirmation number of an existing or newly created appointment.
conversationVariables.label: Appointment Number

conversationVariables.description: The phone number the booking is under, digits only. Used to stamp a new visit and to prove ownership before an existing one is changed. Never used to arrange a call back, because this line cannot do that.
conversationVariables.label: Callback Phone

conversationVariables.description: The caller's first name as they said it.
conversationVariables.label: Caller Name

conversationVariables.description: True once an existing visit has actually been cancelled or moved. Closes both change actions so a single request cannot be applied twice.
conversationVariables.label: Change Complete

conversationVariables.description: Which specialist step currently owns the conversation. Each step stamps this itself on entry, so the router can hand the caller straight back to it on the next turn instead of re-classifying. Never set by reasoning.
conversationVariables.label: Current Flow

conversationVariables.description: True only once the caller confirms everyone is outside and emergency services or the gas utility have been called. Starts false so an unanswered hazard can never look resolved.
conversationVariables.label: Hazard Cleared

conversationVariables.description: True if the caller reported a gas smell, carbon monoxide, a detector alarm, smoke, burning, sparking or arcing.
conversationVariables.label: Hazard Flag

conversationVariables.description: The caller's plain description of what the system is doing or not doing.
conversationVariables.label: Issue Summary

conversationVariables.description: The exact slot token for the window the caller chose to move an existing visit to. Kept apart from the new-booking slot so a token left over from a booking earlier in the call can never move an existing visit.
conversationVariables.label: New Slot Id

conversationVariables.description: True once the caller has been told that plan answers are a what-if because their contract cannot be looked up. Stops the caveat repeating.
conversationVariables.label: Plan Caveat Said

conversationVariables.description: The postal code the coverage or windows lookup actually ran against, reported back by that lookup rather than read from the conversation a second time. Whatever is booked is booked for this postal code, in its time zone.
conversationVariables.label: Postal Code

conversationVariables.description: Either residential or commercial.
conversationVariables.label: Property Type

conversationVariables.description: True once the windows an existing visit can move to have been returned and read out. Nothing can be moved before this, because the caller has to have chosen from real windows rather than named a time.
conversationVariables.label: Reschedule Options Offered

conversationVariables.description: True once the caller has answered the gas, carbon monoxide, smoke and sparking screen either way. Nothing can be dispatched until this is true.
conversationVariables.label: Safety Screen Done

conversationVariables.description: The exact slot token for the appointment window the caller chose.
conversationVariables.label: Selected Slot Id

conversationVariables.description: The street address and city of the property needing service.
conversationVariables.label: Service Address

conversationVariables.description: One of tune_up, maintenance, inspection, or repair.
conversationVariables.label: Service Type

conversationVariables.description: True once appointment options have been returned and read out to the caller.
conversationVariables.label: Slots Offered

conversationVariables.description: True when a technician was found for the caller's area.
conversationVariables.label: Technician Available
